title: Counter copilot output for one customer turn (model output)
description: What the copilot model returns per customer turn. The model extracts indicators, checks the cover story, names its leading hypothesis and picks a question from the approved bank. It does not produce confidence numbers, the pause recommendation or any free-text wording for the teller: code computes those (spike finding 1) and approved wording comes from the bank (spike finding 3).

indicators.description: Every indicator found so far. Quotes are verified in code (see README, quote rule).

stated_reason.description: The customer's stated purpose, in English. Null until stated.

next_question_id.description: ID of one question from the approved question bank given in the prompt. Code checks it exists and fills its slots.
